item.title: Crushed by fallen tree: DBKL ordered to pay over RM800,000 in damages
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Sessions Court here has ordered the Mayor of Kuala Lumpur to pay compensation totaling RM824,180 to a couple whose son died after being crushed by a fallen tree at a public road divider under the maintenance of Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL). Judge Effandi Nazila Abdullah ruled this after allowing the claim filed by Gooi Ling Sim, 61, and Phun Kok Hoi, 63, as dependents of the late Phun Mun Lap, 30, against the Mayor of Kuala Lumpur as the defendant. item.title: New road proposed to ease Tupong traffic congestion
item.description: KUCHING (March 24): A new road linking Jalan Matang and Batu Kawa to the Emart roundabout has been proposed to help ease persistent traffic congestion in the Tupong area.
